name: Teal Aranda
life: “I still remember a calendar where everyone else's birthday came before mine.” Friday often includes a stop at the blocks below Foundry Lofts, where Teal checks the little hand-lettered notices around Harbour Supply.
voice: I want to keep the rota the workers designed even after the owner returns. They put their own birthdays on it first.
appearance: Teal has a high puff tied with plain cord, full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side, and a favorite piece of clothing, a cropped bottle-green coat. It usually goes with a thin silver ring worn on a cord. When somebody else has the floor, Teal rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Teal always notices who paid for the last round. In a group that can be a kindness or a small tyranny, and Teal is trying to tell the difference before the bill arrives.
agenda: To get the workers' birthday rota kept after the owner returns.
family: Michael Gallagher is Teal’s half-sibling. Teal asks the question the rest of the family avoided. Michael chooses an ordinary story to tell. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *The absent signature*, Michael says, “I forwarded her mail through two countries.”
connections: Francis Parra. Carrying flour changes what a shareholder is prepared to say about the workers' rota.

reactions.situation: Two kitchen workers disagree on the new shift rota
reactions.response: Teal puts both proposed rotas beside the actual delivery and childcare times.

reactions.response: Teal walks with them as far as the first landmark and points to the next one from there.
